offering_description.value: Informa TechTarget helps technology vendors and other business marketers reach buyers through lead generation, digital advertising and sponsored content. It sells market research, advisory services and buyer-intent tools to strategy, marketing and sales teams. It produces specialist publications and research and uses audience activity across its websites to identify companies researching purchases.

primary_products.value: market research reports and datasets; buyer-intent data; sales intelligence software; digital trade publications

primary_services.value: lead generation; digital advertising; custom content marketing; research advisory and consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: Enterprise technology vendors, business advertisers and agencies, and corporate strategy, sales and marketing teams

end_markets.value: enterprise IT and cybersecurity; telecommunications and media; healthcare and life sciences; retail and consumer goods; financial services

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Lead generation campaigns, sponsored content programs and custom research or advisory engagements; advertising: Display and newsletter placements across specialist publications; subscription: Access to market research, buyer-intent data and sales intelligence software

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses its editorial audiences and research analysts to deliver campaigns and advisory work to business clients; software / platform: Turns audience research activity into buyer-intent signals and prospecting tools for sales and marketing teams

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Lead generation, trade publishing and advertising, market research and advisory, and buyer-intent software

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving technology vendors, advertisers, agencies and research clients; online: Specialist websites and newsletters, research portals, and sales intelligence applications

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Audience tracking, lead data and direct marketing subject to GDPR, California privacy law and email marketing rules

notes: The exact ordering of the business lines by scale is uncertain.
